summary: TRACK 24.12 Phase A1 · Photo Append P0 regression testing. Backend static-lock suite (49 tests: 4 + 30 + 14) all pass. However, a CRITICAL wiring bug in the V3 SectionPhotos parent component prevents the append fix from ever taking effect on /daily/new: SectionPhotos passes `value={photos}` to <PhotoUpload/>, but PhotoUpload's prop is named `photos`. Consequently, PhotoUpload always sees photos=[] and: (a) never renders thumbnails, (b) photosRef.current is continuously reset to [] via useEffect, so every batch starts from an empty ref and OVERWRITES the previous batch in the parent state. Playwright E2E on the public /daily/new page: batch1=0 thumbs, batch2=0 thumbs, batch3=0 thumbs, reload=0 thumbs. The P0 append behaviour is NOT verified on the running app.

ui_bugs.issue: Passes `value={photos}` to <PhotoUpload/> but PhotoUpload's prop is `photos` (see /app/frontend/src/components/PhotoUpload.jsx line 74-79). The `value` prop is ignored, `photos` defaults to []. Effects: (1) no thumbnails ever render on /daily/new; (2) photosRef.current is stuck at [] because useEffect fires on prop-change and prop is always the default []; (3) Track 24.12 append fix is dead code in this call site; (4) every new batch OVERWRITES prior photos in parent state — the exact P0 the fix was meant to close.

ui_bugs.component: SectionPhotos ticket-photo sub-uploaders (sections.jsx has 2 more `value={...}` PhotoUpload usages for material/other tickets)
ui_bugs.issue: Same wiring bug for `value={m.ticket_photos || []}` and `value={o.ticket_photos || []}` — those pickers are also broken for the same reason.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot verify Track 24.12 A1 P0 fix in the running app because the V3 section wires PhotoUpload with the wrong prop name. Playwright confirms 0 thumbs render after each of 3 batches, and after page reload.

action_items: P0 · FIX WIRING BUG: In /app/frontend/src/components/daily-report-v3/sections.jsx line 1288, change `value={photos}` → `photos={photos}` on the main <PhotoUpload/>. Also fix the two ticket_photos usages (`value={m.ticket_photos || []}` and `value={o.ticket_photos || []}`) → `photos={...}`. This is the ONLY reason the Track 24.12 A1 append fix is not effective on production /daily/new. Without this fix, batch B still overwrites batch A because photosRef never mirrors the real list — the exact regression E1 was trying to close.
After fixing prop name, re-run the Playwright append scenario (batch 3→5→9 → delete idx 2 → reload → payload contains 8 photos).
Consider adding a runtime test / static grep to guard against future `value={...}` wirings on <PhotoUpload/> (component API is `photos`, not `value`).
critical_code_review_comments: sections.jsx contains 3 usages of the wrong prop name `value` on <PhotoUpload/> — an API contract mismatch that silently no-ops without warning because PhotoUpload defaults `photos = []`. Recommend adding a `console.warn` in PhotoUpload if it receives an unexpected `value` prop, OR renaming PhotoUpload's prop to `value` for consistency with form primitives (breaking change across 10+ call sites).

The static regex tests in test_track_24_12_photo_append_fix.py verify the fix exists in PhotoUpload.jsx source but do not verify it is INVOKED by the calling parent (V3 SectionPhotos). Recommend an additional Playwright/RTL runtime test that actually appends a second batch and asserts thumb count on /daily/new.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: In Track 23.1 when V3 sections module was authored, the developer used `value={photos}` on <PhotoUpload/> — matching the common React form-primitive convention. But PhotoUpload's component API accepts `photos` (see PhotoUpload.jsx line 74-79 destructuring `{ photos = [], onChange, testIdBase, forceCamera }`). Because the unknown `value` prop is silently ignored and `photos` defaults to `[]`, three downstream failures occur simultaneously: (a) thumbnail grid `{photos.length > 0 && ...}` never renders → users see NOTHING after picking, (b) the new photosRef mirror (Track 24.12 fix) is continuously reset to `[]` via `useEffect(() => { photosRef.current = photos; }, [photos])` because the prop reference never becomes non-empty, (c) `handleFiles` reads `photosRef.current = []` at start of every batch → batch B's `next = [...[]]` overwrites batch A in the parent state via `onChange(next)`. Reproduction: /daily/new → scroll to Step 5 · Photos → pick 3 photos → 0 thumbs appear → pick 2 more → parent data.photos = [b1,b2] (batch A lost). Mitigation: single-line rename `value={photos}` → `photos={photos}` at sections.jsx:1288 (and 2 sibling ticket_photos usages). Verification: Playwright append scenario above; expected thumb counts 3, 5, 9, 8, 8-after-reload.
